# engine_net: src/engine/net/ and serial/ (tools/engine_layout.py).
# Generated by tools/move_engine_files.py; edited by hand from here on.

add_library(engine_net STATIC)

file(GLOB ENGINE_NET_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cc"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/serial/*.cc"
)
list(FILTER ENGINE_NET_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "_test(_util)?\\.cc$")

file(GLOB ENGINE_NET_HEADERS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.h"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/serial/*.h"
)

target_sources(engine_net PRIVATE
        ${ENGINE_NET_SOURCES}
)

target_sources(engine_net PUBLIC
        FILE_SET HEADERS
        BASE_DIRS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
        FILES ${ENGINE_NET_HEADERS}
)

target_link_libraries(engine_net
        PUBLIC engine_platform absl::core_headers
        PRIVATE absl::str_format
)

if (WIN32)
    # inet_ntop (inet_text.cc) is in Winsock 2, not the wsock32 the games link.
    target_link_libraries(engine_net PUBLIC ws2_32)
    # net_select.cc calls select() through Winsock.
    target_link_libraries(engine_net PUBLIC wsock32)
endif ()

# optional serial port support
find_library(LIBSERIALPORT_LIBRARIES serialport)
find_path(LIBSERIALPORT_INCLUDE_DIR libserialport.h)
if (LIBSERIALPORT_LIBRARIES AND LIBSERIALPORT_INCLUDE_DIR)
    message("Found libserialport")
    message("[MODEM NOISES]")

    target_compile_definitions(engine_net PRIVATE LIBSERIALPORT)
    target_include_directories(engine_net PRIVATE ${LIBSERIALPORT_INCLUDE_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(engine_net PRIVATE ${LIBSERIALPORT_LIBRARIES})
endif ()

# Tests
include(Testing)
add_gtest(
        NAME engine_net_test
        SOURCES inet_text_test.cc packet_test.cc socket_bytes_test.cc
        LIBS engine_net
)
